facts.fact: The Citizen reports the Information Regulator, chaired by Pansy Tlakula, held a media briefing on 13 November 2025 on its POPIA and PAIA work (published date used).
The Information Regulator told a media briefing that organisations reported 2374 breaches in 2024-25 (198 a month) and 1947 since April 2025 (284 a month), a 40 percent rise.

The Information Regulator issued an enforcement notice finding WhatsApp's 2021 privacy policy update violated POPIA; WhatsApp's review action ended in a settlement to be made a court order (no event date given; published date used).
